subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should the public Plugin SDK require yield-capable tools to predeclare sequential scheduling, or explicitly define yield as stopping only future model turns while allowing already-started sibling calls?
rationale: A result-level signal arrives too late to control default-parallel sibling scheduling, so maintainers must choose the permanent safety semantics before this becomes a third-party contract.

options.title: Predeclare yield capability
options.body: Add a tool-level yield capability that forces sequential batch execution and reject undeclared result controls.

options.title: Require sequential tools
options.body: Keep the result API but document and test that every yielding tool must set `executionMode: "sequential"`.

options.title: Accept parallel siblings
options.body: Document that yield does not gate sibling calls already started in the same assistant tool batch.

recommendation.title: Predeclare yield capability
recommendation.body: Add a tool-level yield capability that forces sequential batch execution and reject undeclared result controls.

likelyOwner.reason: They made and merged the underlying clean-turn-handoff design decision for `sessions_yield`.
